record.question: What is the main purpose of contour lines on a topographic map?
record.explanation: Answer A: Indicate elevation and slopes. Contour lines connect points of equal elevation, showing relief and slope from their spacing. Reference: https://www.usgs.gov/faqs/what-are-contour-lines. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: October 2025 examination (cover page); answer time-sensitive wording as of then.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
